description: Form 6251 line 2a follows the deduction actually taken: a filer who elects to itemize (forceItemized) adds back the Schedule A line 7 taxes, not the standard deduction. Single 2025: wages $100,000, SALT $6,000, mortgage interest $5,000 (itemized $11,000, below the $15,750 standard deduction), ISO spread $200,000. Taxable income $89,000, regular tax $14,500 (Tax Table). AMTI $89,000 + $6,000 + $200,000 = $295,000; line 6 $206,900 × 26% = $53,794 → AMT $39,294. (Adding back the standard deduction gave AMTI $304,750 and AMT $41,829.)
